name: National Securities Depository Ltd
title: National Securities Depository Ltd - 544467 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Standalone PAT up 5% YoY in Q4 to INR79.7 crore on subdued capital markets; FY26 PAT INR360 crore (+12.1%), with market share on net account adds at 15.4% and Q4 net share slipping sequentially.

capex.quote: we have c apitalized INR106.1 Page 7 of 18 crores during FY '26, and the technology spends in the current yea r has gone up to INR91.4 crore.

triggers.label: Q4 incremental share ~14% vs 14.7% QoQ
triggers.quote: incremental market share on quarter four coming in at about 14%

triggers.label: Custody fee growth tapering
triggers.quote: there was, a relative slowdown on that particular front, which is reflected in the custody fee

triggers.label: Fintech DP wins from competitor
triggers.quote: One specific broker which was attached with competition has completely stopped and moved to us.

guidance.value: Broadly similar to FY26; next year capex to decline
guidance.quote: We believe this year is also going to be a very similar number as far as tech capex is concerned and opex is concerned.
This year there is going to be a much, much lower addition.

red_flags.label: Net demat share slipped QoQ
red_flags.quote: it was marginally lower compared to the previous sequential quarter, which was at about 14.7%

red_flags.label: Regulator-mandated NDML fee cut
red_flags.quote: there has been an intervention from the regulator which is requiring us to reduce the charges

evasions.topic: Subsidiary revenue potential / Yuva settlement revenue
evasions.quote: Actually we don't measure it like that or track it like that.
So, honestly, Prayesh, I don't want to double guess to this question
